Nothing that belongs to another status is offered, and Complete is not offered before approval.

My observations stand as observations - the bar does take the tabs' place, the ticked lines are not highlighted and there is no Deselect all - but the behaviour is intended, so the check passes. This entry records his decision; it is not mine and has not been altered.

44590.why: Still failing, but my earlier description of it was wrong and is withdrawn. Clicking a purchase order does NOT do nothing - it leaves the list and opens a separate Purchase Order Details page. That page shows the parts with Part Number, Description, Quantity, Cost and Total Cost, and offers Receive, download, email and print. What it does not carry is any of what this check asks for: no vendor invoice number, no invoice date, no delivery note, no per-part tick boxes, no Deselect all, no subtotal with an editable tax and total, no Receive parts with a count, and no sell price.
